integrity: The universal proof is an exact rank decomposition of the published generator/parity-check rows. The packaged verifier independently computes stacked-matrix ranks for three complete finite parameter sets.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the multiplicative-subgroup evaluation set, odd \(q\), the balanced case \(n=2k\), and the fully twisted hook/twist pattern of the source. It does not cover arbitrary evaluation sets, column multipliers, even characteristic, or the source paper's other overlap regimes.
title: Exact hull spectrum of balanced fully twisted Reed–Solomon codes
